patch.summary: Foxit migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Foxit by inventorying legacy project-management fields, mapping them to Foxit objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Microsoft 365, Google Drive, Dropbox before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Adjacent tool — not a project management or work OS platform
Success signal: automations and workflows works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Foxit migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power automations and workflows, docs and collaboration and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Foxit; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Microsoft 365; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Teams needing PDF edit/convert/sign as adjacent productivity outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Adjacent tool — not a project management or work OS platform
If Foxit mapping is poor, compare destination fit with monday.com before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Microsoft 365 in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Adjacent tool — not a project management or work OS platform

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: No task boards, Gantt, workload or PM dashboards as the primary product

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Scored low on work-planning by design for category fairness

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for automations and workflows
Mitigate: Adjacent tool — not a project management or work OS platform
